nom: cocokind Vitamin C Glow Brightening Serum

segments.oily: A reviewer with combination oily-T-zone/dry-cheek skin and one describing an oily-prone complexion both report the serum absorbs without an oily or greasy finish.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry or normal-to-dry skin report the serum feels hydrating, plumping and nourishing, though one reviewer found a reformulated version heavier and greasy on her skin.
segments.combination: A reviewer with combo skin (oily T-zone, dry cheeks) and acne-prone tendencies reports the serum hydrates without breakouts, though it needs to be applied to slightly damp skin to avoid rubbing in oddly.
segments.sensitive: Many reviewers describe very sensitive, reactive, or eczema/rosacea-prone skin; most report no burning or breakouts and reduced redness, but two reviewers with sensitive or eczema-prone skin report burning, stinging, or flaky red patches after use.
segments.mature: One reviewer nearing 50 with normal-to-dry, occasionally sensitive skin reports brighter, smoother, more even-toned skin with zero irritation after six weeks.

concerns.aging: One mature reviewer near 50 reports brighter, smoother, more even skin over weeks of use; another reviewer states the product has no anti-aging properties for her.
concerns.dehydration: Multiple reviewers report the serum leaves skin hydrated, plump, and less tight, including during winter dryness; no reviewer reports it as drying.
concerns.redness: Reviewers with rosacea or general redness report the serum reduces redness and does not irritate; one reviewer with eczema reports the opposite, developing red, dry, flaky patches after burning.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers with eczema are split: several report the serum is gentle and irritation-free even with compromised skin, while one reports intensified burning and lasting sensitivity in the areas it touched.
concerns.spots: Many reviewers, including those with melanated or post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation, report fading of dark spots, acne marks, sun spots, and melasma over days to weeks; one reviewer reports it gave a glow but did not meaningfully fade her hyperpigmentation.
concerns.blemishes: Most acne-prone reviewers report no breakouts and fading of past acne scars, but three reviewers report new breakouts or pimples, including one intense forehead breakout and one reaction within hours.
concerns.oiliness: A couple of reviewers with oily-leaning or combination skin report the serum leaves a glow without an oily or greasy finish; one reviewer describes the current formula as sitting heavy and greasy compared to an older version.

extraits.titre: Broke me out after a few hours of wearing!
extraits.texte: Literally put on in the morning only new product I used and literally by the end of the night I had like 6 pimples! I haven't broke out that bad in months! I have super sensitive clog prone skin!

I recently added this to my skincare routine because I was searching for something to fade my acne marks on my face. I tried this once, and it started burning on my forehead chin and upper lip area immediately after application. This was the first item I put on after washing my face with water only. I let it sit awhile until the rest of my skin felt dry, then I continued with the Cocokind ceramide serum and my regular moisturizer and sunscreen- the burning INTENSIFIED. I thought to myself to just let it sit awhile, but after 5 mins it still burned so I decided to wash it all off. It still slightly stung throughout the day and left my skin feeling sensitive in the areas it burned, but now I have red, dry flakey patches where it burned which I did not have before. Not sure if it were user error, I bought this from ulta so I don't think it could've been tainted with. But I also have eczema and this is on the national approved eczema list. Sadly I don't think this is for me I wish it could've worked!

extraits.titre: The Best Vitamin C in Any Price Range -- The Azelaic Acid is
extraits.texte: I used Cocokinds Vitamin C Glow Serum daily in the morning for 6 weeks. My skin is normal to dry, with occasional redness and sensitivity. Texture & Scent: Lightweight and silky, absorbs quickly. No fragrance or weird Vitamin C smell â€" if youve ever tried the SkinCeuticals CE Ferulic, you know the smell I mean! How it works with other products: No pilling under sunscreen or makeup. It layers well with moisturizers and my other morning serum, which is the Cocokind Chlorophyll Discoloration Serum. Results: My skin began appearing brighter, smoother, and more even within about 8-10 days of use. Over time, I have continued to notice that the glow is more apparent. As someone who will be 50 is 4 weeks, this is something I welcome. Irritation or Sensitivity: Zero. This is THE most gentle Vitamin C serums Ive used. Please dont mistake that for ineffective. That is the beauty of Cocokind products. While they are very gentle, they are still very effective. Would I repurchase? Absolutely. Its affordable, effective, and consistent.

I have been looking for a vitamin C that doesn't break me out. After much research, and comparing product ingredients on all of my skincare, I discovered that butylene glycol clogs my pores and gives me a lot of closed comedones on my forehead. This serum has good, clean ingredients that leaves my skin feeling hydrated and soft. For reference: I have combo (oily t-zone and dry cheeks), very reactive, and acne-prone skin. This serum glides on nicely, but my face needs to be the slightest bit damp otherwise it rubs in a bit odd. Aside from that, it leaves my skin feeling great! I highly recommend this if you're needing a vitamic c serum but struggle to find things that do not break you out!

extraits.titre: Newer formulation feels heavier and greasy
extraits.texte: Unfortunately the formulation of the Vitamin C serum has changed and I'm not impressed with the changes based on how they feel on my skin. I've given it about a month worth of use but it's just not for me anymore. I loved how hydrating the old formulation was, but this newer version sits heavy and greasy. I'm so sad to have to remove this item from my rotation after several years of purchasing.

extraits.titre: Only vitamin c serum that doesn't irritate my skin
extraits.texte: I have super sensitive skin, but still want the brightening and skin tone evening benefits of vitamin c. This is the only one that I have found that doesn't irritate my skin and cause redness. And it's hydrating and has a really nice texture. One of the best drug store options

I suffer from eczema on my face so I'm very particular about what I put on my skin and this works for me. The vitamin c serum has really made my skin shine and not in an oily way. My skin really soaks it up and it looks phenomenal.
